# Introduction to Java

Last Updated : 26 Sep, 2026

Java is a widely used programming language for building web, desktop, mobile, and enterprise applications. It is known for its simple syntax, portability, and powerful features that make development easier and more secure. [...] Android Applications: Java has historically been one of the primary languages for Android development and remains widely used in existing Android applications.
 Minecraft: Java Edition: The Java Edition of Minecraft is developed using Java.
 Apache Hadoop: Hadoop is largely implemented in Java and is widely used for distributed storage and processing of large datasets.
 Apache Kafka: Kafka is primarily implemented using Java and Scala and is commonly used for distributed event streaming. [...] Object-Oriented Programming: Supports modular and reusable code using classes, objects, inheritance, encapsulation, polymorphism, and abstraction.
 Platform Independence: Java bytecode can run on any platform that provides a compatible JVM.
 Robustness: Provides features such as automatic memory management, exception handling, and type checking.
 Security: Includes built-in mechanisms such as bytecode verification, class loading controls, and Java security APIs.

items.title: Features of Java - Tpoint Tech
items.summary:
The primary objective of creating the Java programming language was to make it portable, simple, and secure. In addition to this, several excellent features contribute significantly to the popularity of this language. These features are often referred to as Java buzzwords.

Below is a list of the most important features of the Java language.

Java Features [...] ## Object-Oriented

Java is an object-oriented programming language where everything is an object. Object-oriented programming means that we organize our software as a combination of various types of objects that incorporate both data and behavior.

Java Features

Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) is a methodology that simplifies software development and maintenance by providing specific rules.

The basic concepts of OOP are: [...] Java is platform-independent because it differs from other languages like C, C++, etc., which are compiled into platform-specific machines. In contrast, Java is a "write once, run anywhere" language. A platform refers to the hardware or software environment in which a program runs.

There are two types of platforms: software-based and hardware-based. Java offers a software-based platform.

items.title: What is the benefit of learning Java programming? - ECE
items.summary:
To understand the value of learning Java programming, you need to know what it is exactly. Indeed, Java is defined as a complete programming language. Due to its robustness and scalability, Java is part of large-scale industry applications. Recently, it has gained credibility in the field of Internet of Things (IoT) and cloud development. [...] ## In what situations is Java programming used?

Java is required in the vast majority of domains:

 web development

Web applications operate on a minimum 2/3 client/server architecture. Some Java technologies are used in the development of web applications (Java Enterprise Edition (JEE), Java Standard Edition (JSE), JavaServer Pages Standard Tag Library (JSTL), JavaServer Pages (JSP)).

 Android/iOS development [...] Java programming has many advantages. Logical and easy, Java can be learned with GeeksforGeeks Java tutorials, which will guide you on how to start with Java and get used to it. The free nature of Java is one of the main reasons for its popularity among individual programmers. Indeed, it is free under the Oracle Binary Code License (BCL). In other words, Java is free for development and test environments, but paid for commercial purposes.

### A large Java community

items.summary:
Từ trải nghiệm trên giảng đường, sinh viên N.M.K., năm thứ ba chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin tại một trường đại học ở TPHCM, cho biết tốc độ làm đồ án của em tăng gấp ba lần nhờ AI. Nếu trước đy K. mất cả đêm để tìm một dấu chấm phẩy bị lỗi trong hàng nghìn dòng mã, thì nay AI chỉ mất vài giy để phát hiện lỗi và gợi ý cách sửa. [...] Theo TS Trần Thế Vinh - phụ trách ngành Khoa học dữ liệu, Trường Đại học Giao thông vận tải TPHCM, vấn đề không phải là cấm sinh viên sử dụng AI, mà là làm sao để các em hiểu và làm chủ sản phẩm do AI hỗ trợ tạo ra. AI đang tạo nên làn sóng tương tự thời kỳ bùng nổ Internet, không làm thay đổi bản chất của các vấn đề học thuật mà khuếch đại năng lực con người trên ba phương diện: Tăng tốc độ làm việc, mở rộng phạm vi kiến thức và hỗ trợ đào su chuyên môn. [...] GD&TĐ - Trí tuệ nhn tạo (AI) giúp sinh viên nng cao hiệu suất học tập, xử lý nhiều nhiệm vụ nhanh chóng, nhưng cũng tiềm ẩn nguy cơ lệ thuộc, suy giảm tư duy độc lập.
